title: Pasteles
description: Pasteles is a dish from Puerto Rico featuring plantain, green banana flour, cassava root, achiote paste. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Banana flour and grated cassava approximate the traditional green-banana/taro filling; texture differs.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 18 minutes.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Steam the already prepared parcels or mixture over gently boiling water for approximately 90 minutes, until fully cooked or set.
